eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, NM; at 2:22 PM on AUG 1, 2025 Effective until 5:22 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Flash flooding is imminent in the town of Lincoln and surrounding area. Evacuate or move to higher ground immediately. Do not delay gathering belongings or try to protect your home. Stay tuned to official Lincoln County social media or local news for updates.
